text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Daiichi Ruby & North Flight's â 
Operation Droit de Dress-Up~âª

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: I look forward to your guidance.

Ahead of the upcoming "Ligne Droite", this 
project was organized at North Flight's 
suggestion.

Hearing that Daiichi Ruby would also be 
taking part as an advisor, I decided to 
observe.

text_block_list.name: Participating Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Not just North Flight-san, but Daiichi 
Ruby-san as well?! This is way too 
lavish... are you sure about this?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
You spoke with me very sincerely, 
explaining the reasons for my selection. 
Today, I will mainly be providing advice 
on accessories.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
And I'll be mainly in charge of the dress. 
Fufu! I'm raring to go♪

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
And with that. Would you let me hear your 
order?

text_block_list.name: Participating Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes...! Um, my shoulders are a bit 
broad, so I'd like to conceal that... and 
go for a more mature look overall!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Mhm, mhm... OK! Let's go with this! 
——Let's dress up♪

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
My choice for you is a high-neck halter 
dress! With your broad shoulders, you'll 
look absolutely stunning in this design.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
The oriental pattern gives it a mature 
feel, while the sheer, lightweight fabric 
looks great during dances♪

text_block_list.name: Participating Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Waaah! Huh, amazing, so amazing! You look 
kinda like a foreign model...!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Fashion is meant to bring out and 
elevate the sparkle you were born with. 
You have to make the most of your natural 
shineâª

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Alright! Ruby-chan, you're up next! Please 
take it away♪

text_block_list.name: Participating Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: P-Please treat me well...!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Since it is a dance party, it is perfectly 
fine for accessories to be somewhat 
flashy.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
However, never forget elegance. For the 
necklace, let us go with that gold bib 
necklace over there.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Since the design is quite flashy, we will 
keep the other accessories understated. As 
for the earrings—

Just as she did during the "Trainer 
Selection Exam," Daiichi Ruby selects the 
accessories without a shred of hesitation.

I thought so back then too, but she really 
is exceptionally good at picking out 
clothes like this.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah! It goes perfectly with the 
dress! As expected of Ruby-chan, simply 
flawless♪

text_block_list.name: Participating Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: Yeah, it's so gorgeous. Super mature!

text_block_list.name: Participating Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
...Still, it's a droit we worked hard for. 
Honestly, I kind of want to make it a bit 
more lavish...

text_block_list.name: Participating Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, you're right. After all, it's a 
party.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
...I understand what you want to say. 
However, I would not particularly 
recommend it.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
At a party, the attendees are the flowers. 
There is nothing wrong with dressing up 
gracefully.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
However... a flower's only purpose is not 
merely to bloom beautifully.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: My role is to beautifully adorn the venue.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, what matters is not mere 
beauty... It is beauty suited to that 
specific time and place.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I believe it is a beauty that brings 
radiance not only to yourself, but to the 
entire venue.

text_block_list.name: Participating Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Whoaa~...!

text_block_list.name: Participating Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Whoaa~...!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
It is nothing out of the ordinary. I 
believe understanding time, place, and 
occasion is merely common sense.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Asking Ruby-chan was definitely the 
right call. As expected of high society's 
true fashionista ♪

text_block_list.name: Participating Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Huh, really!?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Of course! It was even featured in a 
business magazine, after all.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Teacher Ruby, please take a look at me 
later too, okay?♪

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
...I believe that is unnecessary for you, 
however.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Not at all. Fashion is quite profound. I'd 
love to learn from you♪

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I believe it is wise to always keep 
that in mind.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. I'm glad I called Ruby-chan over. I 
need to take it to heart once more, too!

text_block_list.name: Participating Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Um, Flight-san, Ruby-san! Could you take a 
look at my dress next...?

text_block_list.name: Participating Umamusume C
text_block_list.text: I want everyone to see it soon too~!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Yes♪ Now let's keep making everyone bloom 
into lovely flowers, Ruby-chan!

And so, Daiichi Ruby had exquisitely 
tailored a blossom to adorn the ligne 
droite.
